ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_sp_d2_heen_k0: Mr. Krabguh is opening a second restaurant and needs a manager. Spongeguh is sure of it: that'll be him. Right?
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_sp_d2_heen_k1: Patguh knows what helps against sadness: the biggest sundae in the whole bubble. Although something is missing...
An ice cream at the Guhfy Guhber
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_sp_d2_heen_k2: King Neptuguh is furious: his crown has been stolen, and Mr. Krabguh gets the blame. Brrr.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_sp_d2_heen_k3: Drive out of the town gate with Spongeguh and Patguh, along the road to The Thug Tug. You're behind the wheel!
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_sp_d2_heen_k4: A tough Mika has your little key. Sneak up to it, and freeze as soon as the Mikas look up. Who was the baby?
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.hint.ijssalon: Spongeguh and Patguh have run ahead to the Guhfy Guhber ice cream parlour (the sundae on its roof), %s. Sit down on your stool at the bar.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.hint.knabbel: Pearl comes running: "Daddy has big news for everybody!" Go to The Krusty Nibble, %s.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.hint.kroeg: The little key is in The Thug Tug, the rusty tugboat, %s. Stand still when the Mikas look up!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.hint.plein: A horn blares across town! Run to King Neptuguh's throne on Bubble Square, %s.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.hint.rit: To The Thug Tug! Get into the Patty Wagon in front of The Krusty Nibble and drive out of the town gate to the east. Your goal: %s.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.klik.bevroren: Mr. Krabguh says nothing: he's an ice cube. Only his eyes follow you. And the nibbles in your pocket.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.klik.meneer_k: Come in, come in! Everybody has to hear it. It's about MONEY. About more money!
Go and have an ice cream with him, colleague. But don't pay for it with my nibbles.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.klik.octo_mik: Whatever the news is: I'm sighing in advance.
Manager. Me. Twice as many customers to dislike. Yippee.
An angry king on the square? Finally something interesting.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.klik.patguh.0: Krabguh has news? I hope it's about ice cream. It's usually not about ice cream.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.klik.patguh.1: ICE CREAM! At the Guhfy Guhber! On Main Street! Or another street! Come on!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.klik.patguh.2: That horn is coming from the square. Or from my tummy. No, from the square.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.klik.patguh.3: I call the front! No, the back. Where's the steering wheel? Never mind, you drive.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.klik.patguh.4: I'm practising standing still already. I'm really good at it. I do it all day.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.klik.sponsguh: Mr. Krabguh has news! I think I'm going to be manager. I'm already wearing my manager socks.
I'm not sad. My ears are just taking a little nap. Shall we go to the ice cream parlour?
Hear that horn? That sounds like a very angry king. Quick, to the square!
The Patty Wagon is out front! You drive, I'll wave.
Being quiet is hard when you're as happy as me. But I'm doing my best. Shh!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.kroeg.balk: Little key: %1$s blocks to go  |  Rest point %2$s/2  |  Seen: %3$s times
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.kroeg.gezien_: Back to your rest point. Once more, nyeg!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.kroeg.regel: Only move when nobody is looking. Does the glass tinkle? Freeze!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.kroeg.rustpun: Rest point %s/2! If they see you, you start again here.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.kroeg.tink: *tink tink* The barman taps his glass...
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.kroeg.weg: You left The Thug Tug. The stand-still game starts again when you come back in.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.einde2_sp_d2_heen: Ah, Bikini Bottom. The recipe is back, the whole town has sung, and everything is the way it should be again, mes amis.
But deep in his office Mr. Krabguh counts his nibbles. And he dreams. Of more nibbles.
A second restaurant! And a second restaurant needs a manager. Spongeguh is sure of it: that'll be him.
What nobody knows yet: the road to Shell City is long, rough and full of tough Mikas. Voilà, nyeg.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.kort.0: To The Krusty Nibble (east of the square)
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.kort.1: Ice cream at the Guhfy Guhber (west of the square)
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.kort.2: To the throne on the square!
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.kort.4: Get the little key in The Thug Tug
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.0: Mr. Krabguh has big news for everybody. Walk into The Krusty Nibble: the big restaurant on Main Street, east of Bubble Square.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.1: Spongeguh is sad: he won't be manager. Patguh knows what to do: ice cream! Go to the Guhfy Guhber ice cream parlour (the sundae on its roof), on Main Street west of the square, and sit down on your stool at the bar.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.2: A horn blares across town: King Neptuguh is on Bubble Square, and he is furious. Run to his throne on the square, next to the lift.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.3: Krabguh is frozen and the crown is in Shell City. Spongeguh and Patguh are waiting by the Patty Wagon in front of The Krusty Nibble. Get in (click the car): you drive.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.3_b: Drive out of the town gate to the east and follow the road to The Thug Tug, the rusty tugboat. Stay on the road: the Patty Wagon stops by itself at an edge. Park in the middle bay.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.4: A tough Mika took the key of the Patty Wagon and is now asleep at his table. Go into The Thug Tug (the rusty tugboat by the road) and take the little key back without anybody seeing you move.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.4_b: Sneak to the sleeping Mika's little key. Does the barman's glass tinkle? Stand still: while the Mikas look, you may not move.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.0: The Krusty Nibble, on Main Street east of the square
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.1: Your stool at the bar of the Guhfy Guhber, west of the square
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.2: King Neptuguh's throne on Bubble Square
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.3: The Patty Wagon in front of The Krusty Nibble
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.3_: The parking bays of The Thug Tug, on the road to Shell City
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.4: The sleeping Mika's little key in The Thug Tug
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.4_: The sleeping Mika's little key in The Thug Tug
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.beloning.ho: Your guhs can now wear the Guhfy Guhber Ice Cream Hat (look in the wardrobe)!
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.hoorn: An enormous horn blares across all of Bikini Bottom. Somebody on the square is very, very angry.
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.rit.bijna: <Spongeguh> There! The rusty tugboat! Park in the middle bay, next to the anchor.
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.rit.instapp: Click the Patty Wagon to get in. You drive!
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.rit.naad: <Spongeguh> According to the map it's only a little bit further. The map is a napkin with a stain on it, though.
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.rit.nieuw: <Patguh> I put the Patty Wagon back in front of the door. It was a bit lost. Just like me.
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.rit.poort: <Patguh> Bye Bikini Bottom! Bye bubble! Bye... er, what was my rock called again?
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen.rit.uitgest: <Spongeguh> Hey, where are you going? We'll wait in the car. Click the Patty Wagon when you want to drive on!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_baby.baby: Only babies blow bubbles in here.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_baby.glas: Hear the barman's glass tinkle? Then they're about to look up. You go. We'll stay here... very... still.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_baby.huiswe: When they look, you stand still. Then they don't see you. That's how I always do my homework.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_baby.ruikt: The Thug Tug. It smells of old grease, wet socks and tough stories.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_baby.stil: Nobody moves. For a very long time. Then the barman shrugs, and everybody looks away again.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_baby.stoer_: Act tough, everybody. Nobody may notice that we're nice.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_bevroren.di: THIEF! Then you get a cold punishment!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_bevroren.fl: That crown has long been in Shell City. Heehee.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_bevroren.ku: This cushion? I thought: a free cushion, I'll take that. Free is my favourite price!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_bevroren.la: HAHAHA! A little square, a little star and a... little thingy! Very well.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_bevroren.mo: To the Patty Wagon! It's parked in front of The Krusty Nibble!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_bevroren.na: That night, mes amis. It is dark. Just imagine it: under a bubble you can't really tell the difference.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_bevroren.no: No! Mr. Krabguh would never steal anything! Well... except maybe a nibble off the floor.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_bevroren.pa: There. A parcel to Shell City. And this empty cushion... goes to Krabguh.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_bevroren.pl: Plan Z, part two. First the king's crown. And then... the blame for Krabguh. Heehee.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_bevroren.sc: My guards saw a parcel leave last night. For Shell City. Where nobody has ever come back from.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_bevroren.ve: Plankmika puts the empty crown cushion on Mr. Krabguh's desk. Evil. VERY evil.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_bevroren.we: Crown? What crown? How much is it worth, by the way? ...I mean: I know nothing!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_bevroren.wi: Then WE will bring your crown back! Me, Patguh and... our new colleague!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_bevroren.za: I saw the crown cushion at Krabguh's! By chance. Completely by chance.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_bevroren.ze: Er, Your Majesty? We live under a bubble. How are we supposed to see when the sun sets?
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_bevroren.zo: If my crown is here before sunset, I'll thaw your boss. If not, he stays an ice lolly forever.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_ijssalon.ge: He's got a point, though. I've never had a little toy either. Never.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_ijssalon.ha: Then the ice cream IS the little toy! CHOMP! ...AAAH! Cold in my ears!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_ijssalon.ho: Here. An ice cream hat for our new regular. On the house. As long as you stop singing.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_ijssalon.mo: It's... beautiful. The most beautiful thing I've ever seen. After a Nibble Patty.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_ijssalon.po: Say.. isn't there supposed to be a little toy with this?
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_ijssalon.sp: ...Sir. This is an ice cream parlour. Not a toy shop.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_ijssalon.ti: An ice cream at the Guhfy Guhber
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_ijssalon.to: Wow... I can't even see the top. Do you think there's snow up there?
Three Guhfy Guhber Nibble Towers! With extra everything, and extra extra everything on top.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_ijssalon.zi: Guhfy Guhber! Guhfy Guhber! GUHFY GUHBEEER!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_kijk_ijssal: The Guhfy Guhber ice cream parlour, with the sundae on its roof. Your stool is at the bar.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_kijk_knabbe: The Krusty Nibble. Mr. Krabguh is waiting inside with big news.
The Thug Tug: the rusty tugboat by the road. The little key is inside.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_kijk_mobiel: The Patty Wagon stands in front of The Krusty Nibble. Spongeguh and Patguh are already waiting.
Bubble Square by the lift. That's where King Neptuguh has set down his throne.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_knipoog_ijs: Ice cream. Snow. Practically the same thing.
Next to his stool stands the medicine chest. He doesn't see it.
Baltoguh in the ice cream parlour
I'll keep looking a little longer, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_kroeg.baby: Come and get it. If you dare, baby.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_kroeg.he: Hey! That's the key of the Patty Wagon!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_kroeg.kroeg: The Thug Tug. Only the very toughest Mikas of the whole void come here.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_kroeg.mooi: Nice little key. It's mine now.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_kroeg.slaap: ...the tough Mika has fallen asleep. At his table. With the little key on his belt.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_kroeg.sleut: Can I hold the key for a bit? I've never held a car key. Only spatulas.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_kroeg.stoer: I'm tough too. Look. Grrr. ...Was that tough?
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_kroeg.tien: Patguh. There are ten more in there. And they're not asleep.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_manager.flu: A second restaurant needs a manager. I've been practising my manager face for years. Look. Look! This is it.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_manager.ijs: SPONGEGUH! I heard something really sad! You know what helps with that? ICE CREAM! Lots of ice cream!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_manager.kin: You're my very best cook, lad. But a manager? You're just a kid. A very square kid.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_manager.maa: But... I've been Employee of the Week three hundred and twelve times! In a row!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_manager.mee: You're coming too, right? The Guhfy Guhber has the biggest ice creams in the whole bubble. It's left. Or right. It's over there.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_manager.nie: Listen up, everybody! The Krusty Nibble is... DOUBLING! Right next door comes The Krusty Nibble 2. Through the wall. Saves on rent.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_manager.oor: Spongeguh's ears droop. Very slowly. All the way down to the floor, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_manager.wor: And the manager of The Krusty Nibble 2 will be...
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_manager.zuc: Hooray. Now I can sigh in two restaurants at once.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_rit.kijk: The Patty Wagon! The fastest bun in Bikini Bottom! With real sesame seeds on the roof.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_rit.voorlop: I've only got a provisional licence. For boats. And Mrs. Puffguh is still crying.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_rit.weg: Out of the town gate, east, and then just follow the road to a rusty tugboat. What could possibly go wrong, nyeg?
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_heen_sleutel_ter: You got it! Without a single little bubble! You're a real silent hero.
I stood very still too. I'm still standing still, by the way. Look.
On to Shell City! Hang in there, Mr. Krabguh! Don't melt! ...No, wait. Do melt. Later.
